author: Primal Space
description:
The discovery of the lost Atocha ship and its treasure was the result of a coordinated effort and some out-of-the-box thinking.

Historian Eugene Lyon’s research led to the discovery that the ship was likely sunk 100 miles away from where previous searches had taken place.

But knowing the location wasn’t enough - now there was the issue of the muddy waters obscuring the divers’ view. Mel proposed a genius solution - by placing tubes next to the propellers, clear water was shot down to the search area. Not only did this improve visibility, but the blasting water also dug out a hole, revealing an enormous clue…
title: A Simple Yet Genius Solution
